memberships.page_title: A 38-Dimensional Hessian Quartic from Five Reduction Strategies

statement: The five-attacks package constructs a 38D Hessian quartic with Hessian Jordan type (35,2,1) and derives exact central-binomial inverse-ray coefficients with infinitely many nonzero Laplacian terms in the stated parity class.
